name: twinsearth-w2m-dsh
description: Run one project across your own Windows and macOS machines from a single DeepSeek account, through 12 w2m_* tools. Four coordination modes (replicate, split, broadcast, pipeline) and six aggregate verdicts (consistent, divergent, divergent-platform, failed, partial, unverifiable). P2P hole punching by default, with a bundled relay, STUN responder and ledger fallback, so the fleet needs no third-party service. Joining needs a pairing code plus autoStartAgent: true; installing alone does not join.
